# Plumbo Plumbing & Heating

> Licensed, family-owned plumbing company serving Regina, Saskatchewan, Canada since 2009.
> Same-day plumbing repairs, drain cleaning, water heater repair and installation, 24/7 emergency
> plumbing (~60 min average response), pipe installation/repiping, faucets & fixtures, sump pumps
> and backwater valves. Upfront flat-rate pricing and a written workmanship warranty on every job.

Key facts:
- Phone (24/7): (306) 555-0142
- Address: 2310 Albert Street, Regina, SK S4P 2V7, Canada
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 8:00–18:00, plus 24/7 emergency callout
- Service area: Regina, White City, Emerald Park, Pilot Butte, Balgonie, Lumsden, Regina Beach, Grand Coulee, Moose Jaw
- Credentials: Saskatchewan journeyman plumbers, gas-fitting licensed, $5M liability insurance
- Rating: 4.9/5 average across 300+ customer reviews

## Services
- [Plumbing Repair](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/plumbing-repair.html): We do same-day plumbing repair right across Regina, and most days we can be at your door within a few hours — under an hour if it's a real emergency. You get one flat price before we pick up a wrench, every repair is backed in writing, and every plumber on our trucks is a licensed Saskatchewan journeyman.
- [Drain Cleaning](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/drain-cleaning.html): We clear blocked drains anywhere in Regina, usually the same day — a powered auger for the everyday clogs, hydro-jetting when grease or tree roots are the problem. On main sewer lines we run a camera afterward so you can see the pipe's clear, and we'll flag any roots or sags before they turn into a basement backup.
- [Water Heaters](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/water-heater.html): We repair and install gas, electric and tankless water heaters all over Regina. Most repairs get your hot water back the same day, and a full tank swap is usually done inside 24 hours — sized right for your household and our cold Saskatchewan water, with the permits and gas-fitting handled by a licensed tech. You don't lift a finger.
- [Emergency Plumbing](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/emergency-plumbing.html): We run a real 24/7 emergency plumbing service in Regina, and we're usually at your door in about an hour. Call (306) 555-0142 and we'll walk you through shutting things down (like closing your main water valve) while an on-call licensed plumber heads your way — and you'll know the price before any work starts.
- [Pipe Installation](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/pipe-installation.html): We run new water and drain lines and do whole-home repiping across Regina, swapping out failing galvanized steel and poly-b for PEX or copper. Most full repipes take 2–4 days, we turn the water back on every evening so you can stay in the house, we keep the drywall openings small and mapped, and the permits and inspection are included.
- [Faucets & Fixtures](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/faucets-fixtures.html): We install and repair faucets, toilets, sinks, showers and garburators all over Regina. A standard faucet or toilet swap takes under two hours at a flat rate — your fixture or one we bring — and we haul the old one away and pressure-test every connection before we leave.
- [Sump Pumps](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/sump-pump.html): We install, repair and replace sump pumps and battery backup systems across Regina, and we fit backwater valves that stop the city sewer from backing up into your basement during heavy rain. Backwater valves may qualify for a City of Regina flood-protection rebate — we handle the paperwork, sizing, permits and inspection with you.
